idea: Seasonal (first day of November, autumn) music clip in the BACKYARD: a big yellow leaf lands on Baby Jimmy's curls ('Oh! A leaf on my head!'); he worries as the apple tree's leaves fall down, down, down; Ava explains 'It's fall! Leaves fall down!', holds up one red and one yellow leaf and asks the viewer 'What color is this leaf?' (pause) – 'Red! And yellow!'; both wiggle their fingers down like falling leaves (copy-me). Loop: the hook framing again, now a red leaf on Ava's head too, bye-bye wave.
title: Oh! A Leaf on My Head! 🍂 Leaves Fall Down | Fall Song for Kids | Crayon Babies
description:
Oh! A yellow leaf just landed on Baby Jimmy's head! 🍂 The leaves are falling down, down, down – but Baby Ava knows why: it's fall! Can you tell her what color the leaves are?

🎬 What happens in this video:
🍁 A big yellow leaf lands on Jimmy's curly hair – "Oh! A leaf on my head!"
😮 "Oh no! The leaves fall down, down, down!"
🍂 Ava sings: "It's fall! Leaves fall down!"
🤔 "What color is this leaf?" – can you answer?
❤️💛 "Red! A red leaf! And yellow, yellow too!"
✋ Wiggle your fingers down like falling leaves! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: in the fall, leaves change color and fall down from the trees • the colors red and yellow • English words: leaves, fall down, red, yellow

A fun sing-along autumn cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers about falling leaves and fall colors – answer the question, wiggle your fingers along and learn new English words with Jimmy and Ava!
